disposition_reason: Primary FAAS data for 14 elements in 66 honeys and bee products (including four bee pollen products) printed as product-type mean ± SD and range in Tables 4 and 5; lead and cadmium not detected in any product.

study.design: Market survey of 66 commercially available honeys and bee products (198 subsamples) with chemometric classification
study.origin: Poland (regions as labelled) and Italy; bee pollen and propolis produced in Poland
study.market: local market in Gdansk and beekeeper shops throughout Poland
study.method: Flame AAS with deuterium background correction after HNO3 microwave digestion; P by spectrophotometry (phosphomolybdate)
study.lod_text: LOD (mg/100 g): Cd 0.003, Pb 0.01, Ni 0.02, Co 0.01, Cr 0.02 (blank mean + 3SD)
study.qa: CRMs tea NCS DC 73351 and cabbage IAEA-359, recoveries 84.5-103%, precision 0.13-13%
